## Issues/Notes

**Owned CI violations**: `ci_violations.json` reports `owned: 0` — none of the 4 red CI checks on `aedcc5b7` has an attributable `path:line` in this PR's diff. Disposition of each (all `unknown` ownership, judged from the raw logs):

| Check | Disposition | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `merge / merge` | **infra (not chased)** — `dmtools run machine_merge` died reading the agents-pack registry catalog: `AgentPackException ... HTTP 504` (GitHub releases 504 window 07:37–08:09Z) | `ci_failures.md` merge log tail |
| `teammate / teammate` | **infra (not chased)** — pack-catalog 504 + `dmtools-github-skill.zip` download failure, leg died before `dmtools run` started | run 42581160351 |
| `docs-freshness` | **infra (not chased)** — the freshness gate itself **passed**; the job died downloading `crap4dart-linux-x64` (curl 504) for the similarity ratchet | run 42580445244 |
| `docs-coverage-tests` | **infra (not chased)** — `dmtools.sh` download 504 ×3; the CLI never installed, no test ran | run 42580445244 |

**All four are re-run by this rework's push** — `5bd0e2113` triggers fresh legs of every workflow; the reds on `aedcc5b7` are superseded. If 504s persist across re-runs, that is a GitHub-side incident, not a PR problem.

**Two commits were pushed** (force-push is blocked in this environment, so the reviewer-sanctioned follow-up-commit variant from thread 1 was used instead of `--amend`):

1. `1e40ba194` — chore: drop the vendored `.cursor/skills` sweep (133 files, −57,904 lines) + `.gitignore` guard
2. `5bd0e2113` — the four in-file review fixes + 6 new tests

## Approach

- **🚨 Thread `PRRT_...LA8v` (scope violation)**: stripped all 133 `.cursor/skills/**` vendored runtime-installer files from the branch and added `.cursor/skills/` to `.gitignore` (with a gh-628-class comment naming the failure class). The net PR diff is reviewable again: 3 files, ~+706/−22.
- **🚨 Threads `PRRT_...LBAr` / `PRRT_...LBE0` / `PRRT_...LBIc` (CI reds)**: infra 504s, no code attributable — replied per thread with the root cause and the re-run; the push re-triggers every check.
- **💡 Thread `PRRT_...LBL-` (probe ordering)**: moved the `prTerminalStateOf` guard out of first-statement position in `triggerWorkflow` to **after every suppression gate** (budget cap → in-flight dedup → cross-anchor → gh-1028 leg guard), still before any dispatch. DRY mode keeps the probe + audit line — the existing DRY-replay test pins it (noted in the thread reply).
- **💡 Thread `PRRT_...LBPn` (double probe)**: memoized `prTerminalStateOf` per `owner/repo#prNumber` **per tick** (cleared at `action()` start) — the thread's option 2. The `recordDispatchFailure` re-probe deliberately bypasses the memo (`opts.fresh: true`): the layer-2 mid-tick merge race requires a fresh record-time read, and the existing `prSequence` test pins exactly that — a naive memo would have reintroduced the #1392 marker-on-merged-PR noise.
- **💡 Thread `PRRT_...LBSq` (shared raw-read)**: extracted `prRawRead(repoInfo, prNumber, throwWarn)`; both `prTerminalStateOf` and `prHeadAndLabels` consume it. The verdict probe keeps its warn + `head.sha` requirement; the dispatch guard stays silent.
- **🪶 Thread `PRRT_...LBW7` (wording)**: single-sourced `TERMINAL_PR_SKIP_MSG` consumed by both lanes; the line now reads `PR #N (merged/closed) — terminal PR — dispatch skipped` — no doubled "terminal", test-asserted substring unchanged.

TDD: every in-file finding got a failing test first (probe ordering ×2, probe-once read-count, wording ×2 failed RED; the error-body contract test pins the refactor), then the minimum `js/smAgent.js` change turned them GREEN.

## Files Modified

- `.gitignore` — `.cursor/skills/` ignored (runtime installer output; gh-628 failure-class comment) — commit `1e40ba194`
- `.cursor/skills/**` — 133 vendored files removed from the branch — commit `1e40ba194`
- `js/smAgent.js` — `prRawRead` helper, per-tick `terminalPrMemo` + `opts.fresh`, `TERMINAL_PR_SKIP_MSG`, guard repositioned after the suppression gates, both audit lines re-worded, `prHeadAndLabels` reworked onto the shared read — commit `5bd0e2113`
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` — harness: `capturedPrLookups` (PR-read counting), `gRun` forwards `workflowRuns`, `gAction` forwards `maxTriggeredWorkflows`/multi-rule; 6 new gh-1402 tests — commit `5bd0e2113`

- `probe ordering — a budget-exhausted tick never pays the terminal probe` — cap=1 consumed by one active run → **zero** `github_get_pr` reads, cap-skip line present, no audit line
- `probe ordering — an in-flight same-key leg skips the terminal probe too` — stub-title anchor match → zero reads

- `shared raw-read — a REST error body (rate-limit shape) fails the guard open in every lane`
- `audit-line wording — single-sourced suffix, no doubled "terminal"` (dispatch-guard lane + validate_pr lane variants)
